newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key JGBs end down after brief afternoon rise.
newsitem.headline: Key JGBs end down after brief afternoon rise.

text.p: The key December Japanese government bond ended down on Tuesday, as a spurt of sales appeared toward the close.
"I think dealers moved to square off their positions ahead of the announcement of the industrial output data," a trader for a trust bank's securities affiliate said.
"Taking into account the market as a whole, there should be more long positions than short positions, which is probably why it (the JGBs) fell toward the close," the trader said.
Key December JGB futures ended at 124.50, down from previous day's 124.74.
